notes:
Composed of {手|しゅ} (hand) + {榴弾|りゅうだん} (shrapnel shell). A small explosive weapon designed to be thrown by hand. The word appears frequently in military history, news about unexploded ordnance, and war-themed media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手榴弾|しゅりゅうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw a grenade
- {手榴弾|しゅりゅうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピン→ピン：00344_pin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to pull the pin on a grenade
- {不発|ふはつ}{手榴弾|しゅりゅうだん}: unexploded grenade
- {手榴弾|しゅりゅうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a grenade explodes

PRONUNCIATION:
Sometimes also read as てりゅうだん, though しゅりゅうだん is the standard reading.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {榴弾|りゅうだん}: shrapnel shell, fragmentation round — the larger artillery projectile
- ⟦{爆弾|ばくだん}→爆弾：10117_bakudan⟧: bomb — a general term for explosive devices
- ⟦{地雷|じらい}→地雷：22476_jirai⟧: landmine — an explosive buried in the ground
